content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (service bundled), a contractual obligation that cannot be billed to the patient. Prior touches used a medical-necessity appeal and data correction, which are the wrong tools for a bundling dispute; neither presented documentation proving the service was distinct and separately payable. Resubmission is permitted since the claim was denied (not paid), timely filing has 64 days left, so attaching supporting records to demonstrate the service is separately payable is the proper next progression.","action":"submit_with_records"}
